machine.name: GOV13_control-crosswalk-assembler
machine.description: Control crosswalk assembler: with parity, AIBOM and the impact assessment in place, the crosswalk assembler builds the auditor evidence pack; a complete pack parks for a review that dwells on the rendered diff, and a distinct human seals it.

inputSemantics: req_audit_pack_seal (binary; fact: cut-release.sh / audit request; partial): an auditor evidence pack seal is requested
gate_3of3_parity (binary; fact: RealityEngine_CI regression run report (parity stages); partial): C++, LSP and Scala agree 3-of-3 on the candidate
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
pack_assembled (binary; aigov-control-crosswalk-assembler completion via aigov.gov13.control-crosswalk-assembler.completion): the pack is assembled
assembler_failed (binary; aigov-control-crosswalk-assembler completion via aigov.gov13.control-crosswalk-assembler.completion): the agent's step failed
missing_receipts (binary; aigov-control-crosswalk-assembler completion via aigov.gov13.control-crosswalk-assembler.completion): receipts are missing from the pack
gate_aibom_pinned (binary; fact: AIBOM verifier over the frame's AIBOM document; new): every model, quantization, tap and dictionary digest is pinned
comp_iso42005_signed (binary; fact: document-workflow close of the frame's ISO/IEC 42005 assessment; partial): ISO/IEC 42005 impact assessment signed
lane_principal_distinct (binary; fact: lifecycle extension: approver != preparer and not an agent (T15); new): the acting principal is distinct from the preparer and human
lane_diff_rendered (binary; fact: GOV11 diff renderer completion, carried by the frame; new): the canonical diff of the exact revision was shown to the reviewer

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

interconnections.purpose: Hand the frame's AuditorEvidencePack to GOV01, its next consumer (agentic-workflow-contract.json W5); never infer a governance verdict from document content.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Assemble the evidence pack in the frame.
